CHN.note: FAOSTAT: China is the world's #1 potato producer (~95 Mt, a quarter of global output). Almost all consumed/processed domestically; modest fresh exports (HS0701) to Malaysia, Vietnam, Russia, Thailand.

IND.note: FAOSTAT: India is the #2 producer (~60 Mt). Largely domestic table/processing use; fresh exports (HS0701) go to Nepal, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Gulf. Imports negligible.

DEU.note: FAOSTAT: Germany ~11.7 Mt. Major EU exporter of fresh potatoes (HS0701) — top supplier to Netherlands and Belgium processing plants. Large net fresh exporter.

FRA.note: FAOSTAT: France ~8.3 Mt and the world's #1 fresh-potato (HS0701) EXPORTER — ships to Spain, Italy, Portugal, Netherlands, Belgium, Germany. Strong net surplus.

NLD.note: FAOSTAT: Netherlands ~6.5 Mt. The world's #1 fresh-potato IMPORTER (HS0701, ~2.9 Mt; Comtrade 2024 total 2,414 kt) — buys table/processing/seed from Germany, Belgium, France, Egypt to feed its huge fry & seed industry, then re-exports.

BEL.note: FAOSTAT: Belgium ~3.9 Mt and home to the world's largest fry-processing cluster. Massive HS0701 fresh IMPORTER (from Germany, France, Netherlands) feeding Clarebout/Agristo/Mydibel. Net fresh importer.

EGY.note: FAOSTAT: Egypt ~6.8 Mt. Counter-seasonal HS0701 EXPORTER to Europe (Netherlands, Italy, Greece, Spain, Germany, UK) and Russia/Gulf in winter/spring. Large net fresh exporter.

ESP.note: FAOSTAT/Comtrade 2024: Spain ~2.2 Mt produced vs ~3.3 Mt used; the EU's largest net fresh-potato IMPORTER (HS0701 ~1.26 Mt, Comtrade 2024) — mainly from France, plus Egypt, UK, Israel for early-season supply.

ITA.note: FAOSTAT/Comtrade 2024: Italy ~1.35 Mt produced; large net fresh IMPORTER (HS0701 ~0.76 Mt) — from France, Egypt, Germany, Poland, Romania.

IRQ.note: FAOSTAT/Comtrade 2024: Iraq ~0.55 Mt; structural net fresh-potato IMPORTER (HS0701) — sources from Iran, Turkey, Egypt, Netherlands, Saudi re-export. Demand outstrips domestic output.

BRA.note: FAOSTAT: Brazil ~3 Mt; net fresh IMPORTER for seed and table supply, mainly from Argentina and Europe (HS0701). Domestic output concentrated in Minas Gerais/Parana.

RUS.note: FAOSTAT/Rosstat: Russia ~18.5 Mt incl. household plots. Net importer of fresh potatoes (HS0701) in 2024 after a weak harvest — from Egypt, Belarus, Kazakhstan, China, Azerbaijan.

USA.note: USDA/FAOSTAT: US ~18.9 Mt. Heavy frozen-fry processing sector. Fresh trade (HS0701) is largely cross-border with Canada and Mexico; net fresh importer some years. Idaho/Washington lead output.

CAN.note: USDA/StatCan: Canada ~5.7 Mt. Fresh (HS0701) trade dominated by the US border — exports table potatoes south, imports from the US in some seasons. Net fresh exporter to the US.

GBR.note: FAOSTAT/Defra: UK ~4.9 Mt. Net importer of fresh potatoes (HS0701) — from Egypt, France, Israel, Belgium; also exports seed to Egypt and Ireland.

POL.note: FAOSTAT: Poland ~7.3 Mt. Mostly domestic; modest fresh exports (HS0701) to Romania, Italy, Ukraine. Roughly balanced trade.

UZB.note: FAOSTAT 2024: Uzbekistan is a major Central-Asian fresh-potato importer (HS0701), sourcing from Kazakhstan (969 kt) and Pakistan (170 kt). Staple winter supply.

FAOSTAT 2024: Belgium->Netherlands fresh potatoes (HS0701), part of the dense Benelux processing loop.

rankings.note: Fresh potatoes HS0701, 2024, kt. Exporters led by France (#1 fresh exporter), Germany, Netherlands, Belgium; Egypt is the largest non-EU exporter. Importers led by the Benelux processing hubs plus Germany, Spain, Uzbekistan, Italy (Comtrade 2024 confirms NLD/ESP). NOTE: the world's largest potato traders by VALUE move FROZEN product (HS2004) and seed, not fresh HS0701 — these rankings cover fresh only.

companies.name: McCain Foods
companies.note: World's largest producer of frozen french fries/potato specialties (~1 in 4 of the world's fries). Private, revenue est. ~US$11bn. NOTE: McCain trades primarily FROZEN potato products (HS2004) and contracts fresh potatoes from growers near its plants; its cross-border movement is processed product, not fresh HS0701.
companies.improve: Should disclose contracted grower tonnage by origin; processed-product shipments are not visible in HS0701 fresh-trade statistics.

companies.name: Lamb Weston
companies.note: #2 global frozen-potato processor (spun out of ConAgra); revenue ~US$6.5bn (FY2024). N. America, Europe, China. NOTE: product is FROZEN fries (HS2004); fresh potatoes sourced on contract, not traded as HS0701.
companies.improve: Should publish fresh-potato tonnage by origin; 10-K gives revenue but not contract-grower volumes.

companies.name: Aviko (Royal Cosun)
companies.note: Major European frozen-potato processor, part of farmer co-op Royal Cosun (~EUR2.7bn group). NOTE: exports FROZEN/chilled products (HS2004/0710); the fresh HS0701 it pulls in is captured in Dutch/German fresh-import flows.
companies.improve: Should separate potato-only and origin-split fresh volumes from bundled cooperative reporting.

companies.name: Farm Frites
companies.note: Family-owned Dutch frozen-fry processor with plants across Europe, Egypt and beyond (~EUR0.8-1bn). NOTE: ships FROZEN product (HS2004); its Egyptian operation links to Egypt's fresh-export base.
companies.improve: Private; revenue and origin-split fresh sourcing are estimates.

companies.name: Agristo
companies.note: Belgian family frozen-potato specialist at the heart of the Flanders fry cluster (~EUR0.9bn). NOTE: trades FROZEN product (HS2004); the fresh potatoes it consumes show up in Belgium's large HS0701 imports.
companies.improve: Private; capacity/revenue are estimates and fresh intake is contracted, not HS0701-visible.

companies.name: J.R. Simplot
companies.note: US agribusiness and major frozen-potato processor (a key McDonald's fry supplier); private, diversified into fertilizer. NOTE: moves FROZEN fries (HS2004); fresh potatoes grown/contracted near plants, not traded as HS0701.
companies.improve: Private; potato-segment revenue and origin-split sourcing not disclosed.

global.note: World potato totals, kt (FAOSTAT). Global output ~376-383 Mt; China + India ~40% of production. World FRESH-potato exports (HS0701) are only ~13-14 Mt — under 4% of production — because most internationally traded potato value is FROZEN product (HS2004) and seed; fresh trade is dominated by short-haul EU and regional flows.
